title: Refresh CHANGELOG.md against the repository's own release history
intent: CHANGELOG.md had drifted to the point of being misleading rather than merely stale. Its newest entry was toolbox-v0.32.0 (2026-01-20) while eleven further releases had been tagged and published, the most recent six months earlier. It carried three separate [Unreleased] sections, one of them below a released version and one of them a roadmap. Work filed as unreleased had in fact shipped up to nine months previously. Three of the four links in its Links section pointed at files that do not exist. This rebuilds the file from tags, release notes and commit ranges, and records what could not be established rather than guessing it.
behavior_change: none - documentation only. No source file, test, schema or configuration is touched; the diff is CHANGELOG.md plus this manifest.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) Eleven missing releases filed: toolbox-v0.33.0-wave22.1, toolbox-mesh-pipeline-v0.1.0, v0.34.0, v0.34.1, v0.35.0, v0.36.0, v0.36.1, v0.37.0, v0.38.0, v0.39.0 and v0.39.1. Five of those (v0.35.0-v0.38.0 and v0.39.1) shipped with Docker deploy boilerplate as their entire release notes, so their entries are reconstructed from the commit range between tags and each entry says so in the text - the reader can tell a sourced entry from a reconstructed one. (2) Three [Unreleased] sections reduced to one, at the top, where Keep a Changelog requires it. (3) Mis-filed work attributed by PROOF, not proximity: the WP-2 API Surface Reduction block moves to v0.35.0 because 57d4ff73 is an ancestor of that tag and services/api/ROUTE_AUDIT_PHASE2_RESULTS.md is absent at v0.34.1; the CNC Saw Lab Execution Completion block moves to v0.32.0 because c35a6936 is an ancestor of it. Both carry an attribution note stating the evidence. (4) The March 2026 instrument-geometry, neck, headstock and photo-vectorizer entries stay unreleased - verified, since the files they describe were added 2026-03-18/19, after the v0.39.1 tag. (5) The B22.16 entry could not be attributed to a release and is grouped under Unattributed rather than guessed into a version; it carries a superseded note because every artifact it names is absent from the tree and the workflows were deleted by f74d4487. The entry itself is preserved - a changelog is not rewritten when the code moves on. (6) The roadmap that was masquerading as an [Unreleased] section is retitled and flagged as planned-not-shipped. (7) The Version History Legend described an A_N.x / B_x / 1.x scheme that no release has used; replaced with a Versioning section describing the real toolbox-vX.Y.Z tag series and component tags. (8) The [Unreleased] section now summarises the 1,716 commits and 277 merged PRs between v0.39.1 and main, grouped by area, and states explicitly that it is representative rather than exhaustive with the tag range as the authoritative record.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: A changelog that stops eleven releases short of reality is worse than no changelog: it silently asserts that nothing shipped after v0.32.0 and that work completed nine months ago is still pending. The file was actively wrong in four specific ways - missing releases, work misfiled as unreleased, a completed-and-since-removed pipeline still marked operational, and three dead links - and each is corrected against evidence from this repository rather than rewritten from memory.

commands_run: gh release list --limit 40 -> 11 tagged releases absent from CHANGELOG.md
git rev-list --count toolbox-v0.39.1..origin/main -> 1716 commits; gh pr list --state merged -> 277 merged PRs since 2026-02-28
git merge-base --is-ancestor 57d4ff73 toolbox-v0.35.0 -> true; git cat-file -e toolbox-v0.34.1:services/api/ROUTE_AUDIT_PHASE2_RESULTS.md -> absent (WP-2 attributed to v0.35.0)
git merge-base --is-ancestor c35a6936 toolbox-v0.32.0 -> true (Saw Lab execution completion attributed to v0.32.0)
git log --diff-filter=A on side_bending_calc.py / nut_slot_calc.py / electronics_layout_calc.py -> 2026-03-18, after the v0.39.1 tag (March entries confirmed unreleased)
structural validation -> 18 H2 sections, no duplicate headings, exactly 1 [Unreleased], all 7 relative links resolve on disk
content preservation spot-check -> CLEANUP-001, GEOMETRY-010, CONSTRUCTION-008, PORT-001, HEADSTOCK-001, VECTORIZER-001, WP-2, Saw Lab, B22.16, A_N.1 Priority 1, P3.4, N17 all still present
py -3.11 scripts/governance/check_all.py --tier precommit -> 5/6 passed, 1 pre-existing warning

files.intent: Rebuild the changelog against tags, release notes and commit ranges. File eleven missing releases, collapse three [Unreleased] sections to one, attribute mis-filed work by proven ancestry, separate the roadmap from the changelog, correct the versioning legend, and repair three dead links.
Per-PR CBSP21 patch manifest enumerating every changed file.
